={{ { campaign_id: $('Validate Creative Input').item.json.campaignId, event_type: 'QUALITY_REVIEW', description: 'Deterministic and AI quality review completed.', metadata: { previousState: 'GENERATING_CREATIVE', nextState: 'QUALITY_REVIEW', passed: $('Combine Quality Results').item.json.passed, issueCodes: $('Combine Quality Results').item.json.issues } } }}

={{ { campaignId: $('Validate Creative Input').item.json.campaignId, packageId: $('Validate Creative Input').item.json.selectedPackage.packageId, spotName: $('Validate Creative Input').item.json.selectedPackage.spot?.name || 'Quiet Cup Cafe', timeWindow: $('Validate Creative Input').item.json.selectedPackage.campaign.slotStartAt + ' to ' + $('Validate Creative Input').item.json.selectedPackage.campaign.slotEndAt, offerText: ($('Validate Creative Input').item.json.selectedPackage.discountBps / 100) + '% offer', constraints: { provider: $('Validate Creative Input').item.json.selectedPackage.providerName, package: $('Validate Creative Input').item.json.selectedPackage.packageName, pricePaise: $('Validate Creative Input').item.json.selectedPackage.exactPricePaise, expectedCpaPaise: $('Validate Creative Input').item.json.selectedPackage.worstCaseExpectedCpaPaise, deadline: $('Validate Creative Input').item.json.selectedPackage.deadline } } }}

={{ { campaignId: $('Validate Creative Input').item.json.campaignId, creative: $json.creative, constraints: { deterministicIssues: $json.deterministicIssues, provider: $json.selected.providerName, package: $json.selected.packageName } } }}
